senses.definition: the practical work of moving, storing and delivering goods so that they arrive on time
senses.definitionCN: 使货物按时到达的运输、仓储与交付实务
senses.example: Good logistics kept the relief supplies moving through three flooded counties.
senses.exampleCN: 良好的物流让救援物资穿过三个受淹的县。
senses.why: The word names the practical art of arranging movement and supply, which is its broad modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指安排运输与供给的实务本领，这是它宽泛的现代义。

senses.title: Military supply and movement
senses.definition: the branch of military work that moves troops, food, fuel and ammunition
senses.definitionCN: 负责调动部队、粮食、燃料与弹药的军事工作
senses.example: The campaign failed for logistics, not for courage.
senses.exampleCN: 这场战役败在后勤，而不是败在勇气。
senses.why: The modern word entered English through military writing, where supply and movement decide what an army can do.
senses.whyCN: 这个现代词经军事写作进入英语，因为在军中供给与调动决定了部队能做什么。

senses.title: The business function
senses.definition: the department or function in a firm that plans transport, storage and delivery
senses.definitionCN: 企业内规划运输、仓储与交付的部门或职能
senses.example: Logistics reports to the operations director.
senses.exampleCN: 物流部门向运营总监汇报。
senses.why: A department is named after the work it performs, so the office that moves goods is called logistics too.
senses.whyCN: 部门以它所做的工作命名，因此搬运货物的部门也叫物流。

senses.title: The arrangements behind an event
senses.definition: the practical arrangements of people, equipment and timing that let an event happen
senses.definitionCN: 使一场活动得以进行的人员、设备与时间安排
senses.example: The wedding ran late because of logistics, not the food.
senses.exampleCN: 婚礼延误是安排问题，不是食物问题。
senses.why: Anything that must be moved and timed needs the same kind of planning, so the word spread from armies to events.
senses.whyCN: 凡是需要搬运与计时的事都需要同类规划，因此这个词从军队扩到活动。

senses.title: The academic subject
senses.definition: the study of flows, using models from operations research and management
senses.definitionCN: 用运筹与管理模型研究流动的学科
senses.example: Logistics borrows models from operations research.
senses.exampleCN: 物流学从运筹学借用模型。
senses.why: When practice becomes teachable, its name becomes the name of a subject.
senses.whyCN: 当实务变得可教，它的名字就成了学科的名字。

senses.title: Transport and delivery in practice
senses.definition: the daily execution of carrying goods, including routing and scheduling
senses.definitionCN: 日常执行运货，包括路线与排班
senses.example: Retail logistics adds a delivery shift at midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 零售物流在午夜增加一个配送班次。
senses.why: The plan has to be carried out on roads, so the daily run keeps the same name as the plan.
senses.whyCN: 规划必须落到道路上执行，因此每日运行沿用规划的名称。

senses.title: Warehousing and stock control
senses.definition: the part of the work that holds goods and keeps records of them
senses.definitionCN: 保管货物并记录其数量的那部分工作
senses.example: Cold-chain logistics needs a warehouse at every border.
senses.exampleCN: 冷链物流需要在每道边境设一个仓库。
senses.why: Goods must stand still somewhere, and holding them is part of moving them.
senses.whyCN: 货物总要在某处停留，保管它们是搬运的一部分。

senses.title: Emergency supply dispatch
senses.definition: the rapid arranging of supplies in a disaster, where time and access are limited
senses.definitionCN: 在灾害中时间与通路受限时快速安排物资
senses.example: Disaster logistics moves water before it moves food.
senses.exampleCN: 灾害物流先运水，再运食物。
senses.why: When roads and time collapse, the same art is practised under extreme constraint and takes a limiting word in front.
senses.whyCN: 当道路与时间都崩塌，同一门本领在极端约束下施展，于是前面加上限定词。

intro.en: Logistics has two suggested backgrounds: a French word for lodging troops and a Greek word for reckoning. The modern military sense is French, and Greek influence is often claimed but not proved. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词有两条被提出的来源：法语中表示「安置部队住宿」的词，以及希腊语中表示「计算」的词。近代军事义出自法语；希腊语的影响常被主张，但未获证实。年代均为约数。

items.en: Loger meant 'to lodge, to quarter'. It came from loge 'hut, shelter', whose own origin is uncertain, possibly Germanic.
items.cn: loger 意为「安置住宿、驻扎」。它出自 loge「小屋、住所」，后者自身来源不确定，可能出自日耳曼语。

items.en: Greek logistikos meant 'skilled in reckoning', from logizesthai 'to reckon' and logos 'word, reason'. It described calculation, not transport.
items.cn: 希腊语 logistikos 意为「善于计算」，出自 logizesthai「计算」与 logos「言词、理性」。它描述的是计算，而非运输。

items.en: Eighteenth-century French logistique named the art of moving and supplying troops. This military sense is the documented source of the English word.
items.cn: 十八世纪法语 logistique 指调动与供给部队的技艺。这一军事义是英语词有书证的来源。

items.en: The resemblance to the Greek word for reckoning is often cited as an influence on the French term, but no direct derivation has been shown, so the link remains a hypothesis.
items.cn: 它与希腊语「计算」一词的相似常被认为是影响法语术语的因素，但并无直接派生关系被证明，因此这一联系仍属假说。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the nineteenth century for military supply, and business adopted it in the twentieth for the flow of goods.
items.cn: 英语在十九世纪借这个词指军事供给，二十世纪商业又用它指货物流转。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same word in other roles; group two holds words for parts of the same practical work.
note.cn: 第一组是同一个词的其他词类形式；第二组是表示同一实务各环节的词。

entries.definition: Relating to logistics; in mathematics the same shape of word names a curve, which is a separate specialist usage.
entries.definitionCN: 指与物流有关的；数学中同一词形的词指一种曲线，属另一专门用法。

entries.definition: A variant adjective used before nouns such as support or problem.
entries.definitionCN: 较长的形容词变体，用于支持、问题等名词之前。

entries.definition: Used of feasibility in terms of transport and supply, as in logistically impossible.
entries.definitionCN: 从运输与供给角度谈可行性，如「在物流上不可能」。

entries.definition: One who studies formal logic, from the Greek word for reason; it looks close but belongs to argument, not freight.
entries.definitionCN: 指研究形式逻辑的人，出自希腊语「理性」一词；形似但属于论证，而非货运。

entries.definition: The movement of finished goods to points of sale; logistics also covers incoming supply and storage.
entries.definitionCN: 把成品送到销售点，而物流还包括进货与仓储。

entries.definition: Goods carried by a carrier, or the charge for carrying them, not the planning.
entries.definitionCN: 指承运的货物或运费，不含规划。

entries.definition: Obtaining goods and services, which happens before they are moved.
entries.definitionCN: 指获取商品与服务，发生在运输之前。

entries.definition: The full sequence of firms and steps; logistics is the work of keeping that path moving.
entries.definitionCN: 指企业与人手的完整序列；物流是让这条路径保持流动的工作。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The word entered English through the military art of moving and supplying troops.
normal.cn: 这个词经「调动与供给部队」的军事技艺进入英语。

normal.en: The family runs the adjective, its longer variant, the adverb and the name for a practitioner.
normal.cn: 同族词包括形容词、其较长变体、副词，以及从业者的称呼。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: logistics company, costs, network, military logistics, last-mile delivery.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出领域：物流公司、物流成本、物流网络、军事后勤、末端配送。

normal.en: The same planning serves armies, factories, hospitals and weddings, because all of them must move things on time.
normal.cn: 同一套规划服务军队、工厂、医院与婚礼，因为它们都必须按时搬运东西。

normal.en: Storage and records are part of the work, which is why warehouses appear wherever the word is used.
normal.cn: 仓储与记录也是这项工作的一部分，因此这个词出现的地方总有仓库。

abstract.en: Picture a map with routes drawn on it and a clock in every corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一张画满路线的地图，每个角落都有一只钟。

abstract.en: Picture a lorry queue at a ramp, each one waiting for its turn.
abstract.cn: 想象月台前排队的货车，每一辆都在等自己的次序。

abstract.en: Picture water arriving before food in a place where roads are gone.
abstract.cn: 想象在道路消失的地方，水比食物先到。

examples.en: The company cut logistics costs by loading full trucks.
examples.cn: 公司靠装满整车降低了物流成本。

examples.en: Military logistics decides how far an army can march.
examples.cn: 军事后勤决定一支军队能走多远。

examples.en: She studied logistics before joining the port authority.
examples.cn: 她在进入港务局之前学过物流。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「log（安置）+ istics（事务）」——把人和货安置到位的事务 → 后勤、物流

root: 这个词有两条被提出的背景：法语中表示「安置住宿」的动词（出自表示「小屋」的名词，来源不确定），以及希腊语中表示「善于计算」的词；近代军事义有书证地出自法语，希腊语影响仍属假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one practical art: goods are moved, an army is supplied, a firm keeps a function, an event is arranged, the subject is studied, routes are run daily, stock is held, and finally supplies are rushed into a disaster.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一门实务展开：货被运走、军队被供给、企业设有职能、活动被安排、学科被研究、路线每天执行、库存被保管，最后物资被抢送进灾区。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a forklift following a marked route in a warehouse while lorries wait at the ramp and a screen shows where every parcel is.
core.cn: 核心意象：叉车在仓库里沿标记路线取货，货车在月台等候，屏幕上显示每个包裹的位置。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY WORK: the general art of moving and storing goods is the broad modern sense.
branches.cn: 日常实务：运输与仓储的整体本领，是宽泛的现代义。

branches.en: FROM THE FIELD TO THE CLASSROOM: supplying an army and studying flows share one body of method.
branches.cn: 从战场到课堂：供给军队与研究流动，共用一套方法。

branches.en: INSIDE THE FIRM: a department and a warehouse are the same function given an office and a building.
branches.cn: 企业之内：部门与仓库，是同一职能有了办公室与建筑。

branches.en: BEYOND THE FIRM: an event and a disaster both need things moved on time under pressure.
branches.cn: 企业之外：活动与灾害都需要在压力下按时搬运东西。

branches.en: THE DAILY RUN: routes and shifts are where the planning meets the road.
branches.cn: 每日运转：路线与班次是规划与道路相接之处。

intro.en: Logistics is a French military noun with a disputed Greek neighbour; its endings are plural in form but singular in use, and its family supplies the adjectives and the practitioner's name.
intro.cn: 这是一个法语军事名词，旁边还有一个来源有争议的希腊词；它的词尾形式是复数而用法为单数，其词族提供形容词与从业者的称呼。

latinIntro.en: The word is French in documented origin and has no Latin relative; the Greek word for reckoning is a claimed influence rather than a proven source.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词有书证的来源是法语，在拉丁语中没有同族词；希腊语中表示「计算」的词只被主张为影响来源，并未证明为来源。

items.example: Its own origin is uncertain, possibly Germanic.
items.exampleCN: 其自身来源不确定，可能出自日耳曼语。

items.example: The verb described where soldiers slept before it described where supplies went.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词先说士兵睡在哪里，后说补给去哪里。

items.meaning: the art of moving and supplying troops
items.meaningCN: 调动与供给部队的技艺
items.example: The military sense is the documented source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 军事义是英语词有书证的来源。

items.example: The suffix makes a name for a body of practical method.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀为成套实务方法造出名称。

items.structure: -s (English plural ending used as a singular noun)
items.meaning: a body of work treated as one subject
items.meaningCN: 被当作一门学问的整体工作
